description: Scrape restaurant listings from Glovo by city, or search by keyword within a city.

city.description: City to scrape Glovo restaurants for.
city.title: City

cuisine.description: Optional. Filter restaurants by cuisine tag (case-insensitive substring match), e.g. `Pizza`, `Sushi`, `Italiana`, `Burgers`. Cuisine tags are shown in the local language of the selected city.
cuisine.title: Cuisine filter

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Glovo shows up to 50 restaurants per city/food category page.
maxItems.title: Max items

minRating.description: Drop restaurants with a customer satisfaction score (0-100) below this value.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: `Browse restaurants` lists every restaurant Glovo shows for the selected city (optionally filtered by cuisine). `Search` additionally filters those restaurants by a keyword matched against the restaurant name and cuisine tag.
mode.title: Mode

onlyOpen.description: Only return restaurants that are currently open for delivery.
onlyOpen.title: Only currently open

onlyTopRated.description: Only return restaurants Glovo has flagged as top-rated.
onlyTopRated.title: Only top-rated

onlyWithPromotions.description: Only return restaurants that currently have at least one active discount/deal (e.g. percentage off, 2x1).
onlyWithPromotions.title: Only with active promotions

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Glovo does not require a proxy from most locations, but you can enable Apify's free datacenter proxy (AUTO group) for extra reliability.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

query.description: Required when mode=search. Matched (case-insensitive) against restaurant name and cuisine tag, e.g. `pizza`, `sushi`, `mcdonald`.
query.title: Search keyword

title: Glovo Restaurant Scraper Input
